draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Hope the notification badge issue has stayed fixed since Tariq closed it out last week -- do say if it reappears.

Nice work getting your first project created and an invite out. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding the real work into that project is usually the step that makes it click for a team. If it's helpful, I can walk you through that on a short call this week.

Best,
Nadia
